title: The input of spend.limits.set, and its answer in $defs/result (DEC-0183 SL-2)
description: Changes one spending limit a service lists in its usage report's budgets[] with editable: true: its limitUsd, its enforced, or both (at least one: minProperties 4, the three required members and one change). The capability is the twin of the dashboard's edit (DEC-0121 AP-1), declared as the action spend.limits.set with gate relayed. A change that only tightens (a lower limitUsd, enforced turned on) is the caller's own act; one that raises limitUsd, clears it (null) or turns enforced off is the operator's: the call carries the decision in _meta.decision (AP-2), and without it the service refuses operator-decision-required. Typed refusals: unknown-limit, limit-not-editable, invalid-amount, operator-decision-required, decision-invalid. DEC-0183 SL-2, docs/specification/service.md#changing-a-limit-dec-0183.

limitId.description: The id of a budgets[] entry.

limitUsd.description: The new line in USD; null clears it (only a relative limit may be null, FAC-SEM-031). Absent: unchanged.

idempotencyKey.description: A retry with the same key and arguments answers the first result.

result.description: The answer: the change recorded, as limitChanges[] lists it.

repeated.description: true when the idempotency key answered an earlier call.
